activity.working.description: Tooltip and screen-reader text of the spinner beside an agent session in a list (Messages, the Homeroom menu): the coding agent is working on that conversation right now.

activity.finished.description: Tooltip and screen-reader text of the green dot beside an agent session in a list: the agent finished a turn the person has not looked at yet.

session.attach.imageTooBig.text: "{{file}}" is too big. Images max {{megabytes}} MB.
session.attach.imageTooBig.description: Error under the message box of an agent session when a picked image is over the size limit. {{file}} is the file's name, {{megabytes}} the limit as a whole number of megabytes.

session.attach.zipTooBig.text: "{{file}}" is too big. Zip archives max {{megabytes}} MB.
session.attach.zipTooBig.description: Error under the message box of an agent session when a picked zip archive is over the size limit. {{file}} is the file's name, {{megabytes}} the limit as a whole number of megabytes.

session.attach.fileTooBig.text: "{{file}}" is too big. Files max {{megabytes}} MB.
session.attach.fileTooBig.description: Error under the message box of an agent session when a picked file (not an image or a zip) is over the size limit. {{file}} is the file's name, {{megabytes}} the limit as a whole number of megabytes.

session.attach.empty.description: Error under the message box of an agent session when a picked file has no content and cannot be attached. {{file}} is the file's name.

session.attach.tooMany_one.text: You can attach up to {{count}} file to one message.
session.attach.tooMany_one.description: Error under the message box of an agent session when more files were picked than one message may carry. {{count}} is the limit (4 today).

session.attach.tooMany_other.text: You can attach up to {{count}} files to one message.
session.attach.tooMany_other.description: Error under the message box of an agent session when more files were picked than one message may carry. {{count}} is the limit (4 today).

session.fixChecks.headingPr_one.description: Heading of the card at the end of an agent session that offers to fix a change's failing automated checks. {{count}} is how many checks failed; {{number}} is the pull request's number. PR is the abbreviation of pull request.

session.fixChecks.headingPr_other.description: Heading of the card at the end of an agent session that offers to fix a change's failing automated checks. {{count}} is how many checks failed; {{number}} is the pull request's number. PR is the abbreviation of pull request.

session.fixChecks.headingChange_one.description: Heading of the card at the end of an agent session that offers to fix a change's failing automated checks. {{count}} is how many checks failed. Used before the change has a pull request; "change" is a noun, the code change the agent is building.

session.fixChecks.headingChange_other.description: Heading of the card at the end of an agent session that offers to fix a change's failing automated checks. {{count}} is how many checks failed. Used before the change has a pull request; "change" is a noun, the code change the agent is building.

session.fixChecks.askPr_one.text: Please fix the failing check on PR #{{number}}.
session.fixChecks.askPr_one.description: First line of the message that the "Fix it" button sends to the coding agent in the person's own name, asking it to fix failing automated checks. {{count}} is how many checks failed; {{number}} is the pull request's number. {{count}} is available in this form too, although English does not show it: a language whose singular form is also used for 21 or 101 should print the number.

session.fixChecks.askPr_other.text: Please fix the {{count}} failing checks on PR #{{number}}.
session.fixChecks.askPr_other.description: First line of the message that the "Fix it" button sends to the coding agent in the person's own name, asking it to fix failing automated checks. {{count}} is how many checks failed; {{number}} is the pull request's number.

session.fixChecks.askChange_one.text: Please fix the failing check on this change.
session.fixChecks.askChange_one.description: First line of the message that the "Fix it" button sends to the coding agent in the person's own name, asking it to fix failing automated checks. {{count}} is how many checks failed. Used before the change has a pull request; "change" is a noun. {{count}} is available in this form too, although English does not show it: a language whose singular form is also used for 21 or 101 should print the number.

session.fixChecks.askChange_other.text: Please fix the {{count}} failing checks on this change.
session.fixChecks.askChange_other.description: First line of the message that the "Fix it" button sends to the coding agent in the person's own name, asking it to fix failing automated checks. {{count}} is how many checks failed. Used before the change has a pull request; "change" is a noun.

session.fixChecks.askLine.description: One list line in the message that "Fix it" sends to the coding agent: a failing check that reported nothing. {{check}} is the check's name. Keep the leading hyphen and the quotation marks.

session.fixChecks.askLineReason.description: One list line in the message that "Fix it" sends to the coding agent: a failing check and what it reported. {{check}} is the check's name, {{reason}} the check's own failure output. Keep the leading hyphen.

session.fixChecks.askMore_one.description: Last list line in the message that "Fix it" sends to the coding agent, when more checks failed than the lines above name. {{count}} is how many failing checks are not listed. Keep the leading hyphen.

session.fixChecks.askMore_other.description: Last list line in the message that "Fix it" sends to the coding agent, when more checks failed than the lines above name. {{count}} is how many failing checks are not listed. Keep the leading hyphen.

session.requestSeed.titled.description: Message offered in the message box of a new agent session that was started from a request (a member's filed suggestion or bug report for an app). The person sends it to the agent as their own words. {{number}} is the request's number, {{title}} its title.

session.requestSeed.untitled.description: Message offered in the message box of a new agent session that was started from a request (a member's filed suggestion or bug report) that has no title. {{number}} is the request's number.

session.userMessage.showLess.description: Button at the end of the person's own long message in an agent session, once it is unfolded: folds the message back to its first lines.

session.userMessage.showMore.description: Button on the person's own long message in an agent session, shown folded to its first lines: unfolds the whole message.

session.effort.minimal.description: One of the thinking levels offered for a model in the agent session's "Build with" sheet, also shown after the model's name on the model button: how much reasoning effort the model spends. The lowest level.

session.effort.low.description: One of the thinking levels offered for a model in the agent session's "Build with" sheet, also shown after the model's name on the model button: how much reasoning effort the model spends. The second lowest level.

session.effort.medium.description: One of the thinking levels offered for a model in the agent session's "Build with" sheet, also shown after the model's name on the model button: how much reasoning effort the model spends. The middle level.

session.effort.high.description: One of the thinking levels offered for a model in the agent session's "Build with" sheet, also shown after the model's name on the model button: how much reasoning effort the model spends. The second highest level.

session.effort.xhigh.description: One of the thinking levels offered for a model in the agent session's "Build with" sheet, also shown after the model's name on the model button: how much reasoning effort the model spends. The highest level.

session.effort.default.description: First option in the list of thinking levels in the agent session's "Build with" sheet, when the server names no default level: the model uses whatever level the platform is set to.

session.model.title.openRouter.description: Tooltip of a model in the agent session's model list: this model is paid for with the person's own OpenRouter API key. OpenRouter is a company name.

session.model.title.openRouterClaudeCode.text: Runs on your OpenRouter key, in Claude Code
session.model.title.openRouterClaudeCode.description: Tooltip of a model in the agent session's model list: paid for with the person's own OpenRouter API key and run by the Claude Code coding tool. OpenRouter and Claude Code are product names.

session.model.title.anthropic.text: Runs on the platform Claude allowance, or your own Anthropic key
session.model.title.anthropic.description: Tooltip of a Claude model in the agent session's model list: it is paid from the allowance Homeroom gives, or from the person's own Anthropic API key. Claude and Anthropic are names.

session.model.cost.description: Estimate under a model's name in the agent session's model list. {{amount}} is a price in US dollars with its sign, for example $1.55 or <$0.01. "change" is a noun: one code change built by the agent. Starts lower case; it follows the model's name.

session.model.costWithNote.description: Line under a model's name in the agent session's model list: a short note about the model, then the estimate. {{note}} is the platform's own note, for example "general coding work"; {{amount}} is a price in US dollars with its sign. Keep the middle dot between them.

session.credits.left.description: Text of the credits button beside the message box of an agent session: how much of the person's AI allowance remains. {{amount}} is a dollar amount such as $38 or $4.10.

session.credits.noneLeft.description: Text of the credits button beside the message box of an agent session when the person's AI allowance is used up: no credits remain.

session.credits.wideLeft.description: Text of the credits button beside the message box when there is room for the allowance too: what remains, then the whole allowance after a slash. {{amount}} and {{allowance}} are dollar amounts such as $38 and $50.

session.credits.wideNoneLeft.description: Text of the credits button beside the message box when nothing remains and there is room for the allowance too. {{allowance}} is the whole allowance as a dollar amount such as $50.

session.credits.pillWideLeft.description: Text of the credits button beside the message box on a wide screen: what remains, then the whole allowance in a muted colour. {{amount}} and {{allowance}} are dollar amounts such as $38 and $50. Keep the <0> tags around the slash and the allowance.

session.credits.pillWideNoneLeft.description: Text of the credits button beside the message box on a wide screen when nothing remains. {{allowance}} is the whole allowance as a dollar amount. Keep the <0> tags around the slash and the allowance.

session.credits.describeWeek.description: Tooltip of the credits button and the line under the credits bar in the "Build with" sheet, for an allowance that renews weekly. {{remaining}} is what is left and {{allowance}} the week's whole allowance, both exact dollar amounts such as $38.40 and $50.00.

session.credits.describeDay.description: Tooltip of the credits button and the line under the credits bar in the "Build with" sheet, for an allowance that renews daily. {{remaining}} is what is left and {{allowance}} the day's whole allowance, both exact dollar amounts.

session.credits.pillLabelWeek.description: Accessible name of the credits button beside the message box of an agent session, for a weekly allowance. {{remaining}} and {{allowance}} are exact dollar amounts such as $38.40 and $50.00.

session.credits.pillLabelDay.description: Accessible name of the credits button beside the message box of an agent session, for a daily allowance. {{remaining}} and {{allowance}} are exact dollar amounts.

session.credits.headingWeek.description: Heading of the credits card in the agent session's "Build with" sheet when the AI allowance renews weekly.

session.credits.headingDay.description: Heading of the credits card in the agent session's "Build with" sheet when the AI allowance renews daily.

session.credits.meterLabel.description: Accessible name of the bar in the credits card of the "Build with" sheet: it shows how much of the AI allowance remains.

session.credits.ownKeyToday.description: Note in the credits card of the "Build with" sheet: how much the person spent today through their own API key, which does not count against Homeroom credits. {{amount}} is an exact dollar amount such as $1.20.

session.credits.lowNote.text: Only {{amount}} of credits left. A build can cost more than that and may stop partway. To keep going, <0>add your own Anthropic API key</0> or wait for your free credits to reset.
session.credits.lowNote.description: Note above the send row of an agent session, shown whenever the credits pill beside Send is red because less than 15% of the AI allowance is left — before the first message and once the conversation is under way. What remains may not cover a build, which may stop partway; the note also names the two ways to keep going, as the out-of-credits card does. It is a note, not a block; the person can still send. {{amount}} is a dollar amount such as $0.60, written the way the credits pill writes it. Tag 0 links to Settings, API key.

session.credits.lowNoteNone.text: No credits left. A build may not start, or may stop partway. To keep going, <0>add your own Anthropic API key</0> or wait for your free credits to reset.
session.credits.lowNoteNone.description: Note above the send row of an agent session, shown whenever the credits pill beside Send is red and nothing at all remains of the AI allowance — before the first message and once the conversation is under way. A build may not start, or may stop partway; the note also names the two ways to keep going, as the out-of-credits card does. It is a note, not a block; the person can still send. Tag 0 links to Settings, API key.

session.credits.confirmContinue.description: Button of the low-credits check in the agent session's composer, shown when Send is pressed with less than a dollar or less than 10% of the AI allowance left: it sends the message anyway, and the check is not shown again for the rest of the visit.

session.credits.confirmCancel.description: Button of the low-credits check in the agent session's composer, shown when Send is pressed with less than a dollar or less than 10% of the AI allowance left: it closes the check and nothing is sent; the message stays in the box.

session.model.pillLabel.description: Accessible name of the model button beside the message box of an agent session; pressing it opens the "Build with" sheet. {{model}} is the AI model's full name, for example Claude Opus 5.5.

session.model.pillLabelThinking.description: Accessible name of the model button beside the message box when the model has a thinking level. {{model}} is the AI model's full name; {{level}} is the thinking level as the button shows it, for example High.

session.buildWith.homeroomIntro.text: The agent builds it here, on your Homeroom credits.
session.buildWith.homeroomIntro.description: First line of the Homeroom tab in the agent session's "Build with" sheet: choosing this tab means Homeroom's own coding agent builds the change, paid from the person's Homeroom AI allowance.

session.model.listHeading.description: Small heading over the list of AI models in the agent session's "Build with" sheet.

session.model.defaultTag.description: Small lower-case tag after a model's name in the agent session's model list: the model a conversation uses when the person has not chosen one.

session.effort.rowLabel.description: Row in the agent session's "Build with" sheet; pressing it unfolds the list of thinking levels (how much reasoning effort the model spends). The current level is shown beside it.

session.effort.defaultTag.description: Small lower-case tag after a thinking level in the agent session's "Build with" sheet: the level used when the person has not chosen one.

session.buildWith.heading.description: Heading of the sheet opened from the model button in an agent session. Its tabs (Homeroom, Claude Code, Codex) are what the person can build a change with; "Build" is a verb.

session.buildWith.tabsLabel.description: Accessible name of the row of tabs (Homeroom, Claude Code, Codex) in the agent session's "Build with" sheet; "Build" is a verb.

session.buildWith.dialogLabel.description: Accessible name of the sheet opened from the model button in an agent session, where the person chooses what to build a change with; "Build" is a verb.

session.handoff.lead.update.text: {{agent}} builds on your own {{product}} plan and pushes to your fork of the app; its work comes back as an update to this change. No Homeroom credits.
session.handoff.lead.update.description: First paragraph of a Claude Code or Codex tab in the agent session's "Build with" sheet: what handing the work to that outside tool means. {{agent}} is the coding tool, Claude Code or Codex; {{product}} is the account it runs on, Claude or ChatGPT. "change" is a noun, the code change being built; a fork is the person's own copy of the app's repository. Used when the conversation already has a change.

session.handoff.lead.newChange.text: {{agent}} builds on your own {{product}} plan and pushes to your fork of the app; its work comes back as a new change. No Homeroom credits.
session.handoff.lead.newChange.description: First paragraph of a Claude Code or Codex tab in the agent session's "Build with" sheet: what handing the work to that outside tool means. {{agent}} is the coding tool, Claude Code or Codex; {{product}} is the account it runs on, Claude or ChatGPT. "change" is a noun, the code change being built; a fork is the person's own copy of the app's repository. Used when the work would start a new change.

session.handoff.lead.newChangeOnApp.text: {{agent}} builds on your own {{product}} plan and pushes to your fork of the app; its work comes back as a new change on {{app}}. No Homeroom credits.
session.handoff.lead.newChangeOnApp.description: First paragraph of a Claude Code or Codex tab in the agent session's "Build with" sheet: what handing the work to that outside tool means. {{agent}} is the coding tool, Claude Code or Codex; {{product}} is the account it runs on, Claude or ChatGPT. "change" is a noun, the code change being built; a fork is the person's own copy of the app's repository. Used when the work would start a new change; {{app}} is the app's name.

session.handoff.check.github.description: One of three setup checks in the hand-off tab of the "Build with" sheet, with a tick when done: the person's GitHub account is linked to Homeroom.

session.handoff.check.fork.description: One of three setup checks in the hand-off tab of the "Build with" sheet, with a tick when done: the person's own copy (fork) of the app's repository exists.

session.handoff.check.connector.description: One of three setup checks in the hand-off tab of the "Build with" sheet, with a tick when done: the Homeroom connector is added to the person's account in {{product}}, which is Claude or ChatGPT.

session.handoff.check.done.description: Screen-reader text after a setup check in the hand-off tab whose tick is shown: this step is complete.

session.handoff.check.notDone.description: Screen-reader text after a setup check in the hand-off tab that has no tick: this step is still to do.

session.handoff.statusFailed.text: Could not check where the hand-off stands.
session.handoff.statusFailed.description: Error in the hand-off tab of the "Build with" sheet when the request for the setup checks failed and the server gave no reason.

session.handoff.unavailable.text: Handing work to Claude Code or Codex is unavailable right now.
session.handoff.unavailable.description: Note in the hand-off tab of the "Build with" sheet when this server cannot hand work to an outside coding tool. Claude Code and Codex are product names.

session.handoff.copied.text: Copied. Paste it into the new {{agent}} session.
session.handoff.copied.description: Green confirmation in the hand-off tab after the instructions were copied to the clipboard and the tool opened in a new tab. {{agent}} is Claude Code or Codex.

session.handoff.copyFailed.text: Could not copy. Copy the instructions below by hand, then paste them into the new session.
session.handoff.copyFailed.description: Amber warning in the hand-off tab when copying the instructions to the clipboard failed; the instructions are shown unfolded underneath.

session.handoff.nothingYet.text: There is nothing to hand over yet. Tell the agent which app to change first, then come back here.
session.handoff.nothingYet.description: Shown in the hand-off tab of the "Build with" sheet when the conversation is not about any app yet, so there is no work to pass to Claude Code or Codex. "change" is a verb here.

session.handoff.checking.description: Status line in the hand-off tab while the setup checks (GitHub linked, fork ready, connector added) are loading.

session.handoff.connector.heading.description: Heading of the setup steps in the hand-off tab for adding Homeroom as a connector. {{product}} is Claude or ChatGPT.

session.handoff.connector.serverUrl.description: Line in the connector setup steps of the hand-off tab. {{url}} is the web address to paste into the other product; MCP is a protocol name and stays as it is. Keep the <0> tags around the address.

session.handoff.connector.startNew.text: Then start a new {{product}} conversation: one you already had open will not see a connector added after it started.
session.handoff.connector.startNew.description: Small note under the connector setup steps in the hand-off tab. {{product}} is Claude or ChatGPT.

session.handoff.connector.checkAgain.description: Button under the connector setup steps in the hand-off tab: the person says the connector is added and Homeroom checks the setup again.

session.handoff.connector.moreSettings.description: Link under the connector setup steps in the hand-off tab: opens the Connectors section of Settings.

session.handoff.carried.heading.description: Heading of the card in the hand-off tab, once setup is done, that says what the copied instructions carry to the outside coding tool.

session.handoff.carried.specTitled.description: Line in the hand-off tab's "Handed over with the instructions" card: the instructions include the plan from this conversation (the written description of what the change will do). {{title}} is the change's title.

session.handoff.carried.spec.description: Line in the hand-off tab's "Handed over with the instructions" card: the instructions include the plan from this conversation (the written description of what the change will do), which has no title to show.

session.handoff.carried.noSpec.text: No plan yet, so {{agent}} will ask what to build.
session.handoff.carried.noSpec.description: Line in the hand-off tab's "Handed over with the instructions" card when the conversation has no plan yet (the written description of what the change will do). {{agent}} is Claude Code or Codex.

session.handoff.copyAndOpen.description: Main button of the hand-off tab once setup is done: copies the instructions to the clipboard and opens the tool in a new browser tab. {{agent}} is Claude Code or Codex.

session.handoff.pasteHint.text: Paste into the new session. It starts building straight away.
session.handoff.pasteHint.description: Hint under the "Copy instructions and open" button in the hand-off tab: what to do in the tool that just opened.

session.handoff.instructions.description: Label of the fold in the hand-off tab that shows the full text of the instructions for the outside coding tool, to read or copy by hand.

session.creditsCard.usedUp.text: Your Homeroom credits are used up.
session.creditsCard.usedUp.description: Heading of the amber card in an agent session when a message was refused because the person's AI allowance ran out and the server gave no sentence of its own.

session.propose.question.text: Put this up for the group’s vote?
session.propose.question.description: Question at the top of the small confirmation panel opened by "Propose to group" in an agent session: the change the agent built would go to the community's vote.

session.propose.line.titled.text: “{{title}}” goes to the vote. Its preview and checks run again on the way.
session.propose.line.titled.description: Line in the "Propose to group" confirmation panel of an agent session saying which change goes to the community's vote and that its preview build and automated checks run again first. {{title}} is the proposal title typed above. Keep the quotation marks around it.

session.propose.line.titledPr.text: “{{title}}” (PR #{{number}}) goes to the vote. Its preview and checks run again on the way.
session.propose.line.titledPr.description: Line in the "Propose to group" confirmation panel of an agent session saying which change goes to the community's vote and that its preview build and automated checks run again first. {{title}} is the proposal title typed above; {{number}} is the pull request's number (PR is its abbreviation).

session.propose.line.untitled.text: “This change” goes to the vote. Its preview and checks run again on the way.
session.propose.line.untitled.description: Line in the "Propose to group" confirmation panel of an agent session saying which change goes to the community's vote and that its preview build and automated checks run again first. Used when the title box is empty; "change" is a noun.

session.propose.line.untitledPr.text: “This change” (PR #{{number}}) goes to the vote. Its preview and checks run again on the way.
session.propose.line.untitledPr.description: Line in the "Propose to group" confirmation panel of an agent session saying which change goes to the community's vote and that its preview build and automated checks run again first. Used when the title box is empty; {{number}} is the pull request's number. "change" is a noun.

session.propose.titleLabel.description: Label of the text box in the "Propose to group" confirmation panel: the title the proposal will carry in the vote. "Proposal" is a noun.

session.propose.titlePlaceholder.description: Placeholder in the proposal title box of the "Propose to group" panel when the change has no title; "change" is a noun.

session.propose.confirm.description: Confirm button in the "Propose to group" panel of an agent session: a verb, puts the change up for the community's vote.

session.propose.proposing.description: Text of the "Propose to group" button on a change's preview card while the change is being put up for the vote.

session.propose.button.description: Button on a change's preview card in an agent session: opens the confirmation to put the change up for the community's vote. "Propose" is a verb.

session.card.field.app.description: Row label on a confirmation card in an agent session (the card lists what an action the agent wants to take will be run with, and the person confirms or dismisses it). The value beside it is the app the action is for.

session.card.field.changeTitle.description: Row label on a confirmation card in an agent session (the card lists what an action the agent wants to take will be run with, and the person confirms or dismisses it). A noun: the value beside it is the title of the code change.

session.card.field.change.description: Row label on a confirmation card in an agent session (the card lists what an action the agent wants to take will be run with, and the person confirms or dismisses it). A noun: the value beside it is the number of the code change, such as #88.

session.card.field.proposal.description: Row label on a confirmation card in an agent session (the card lists what an action the agent wants to take will be run with, and the person confirms or dismisses it). A noun: the value beside it is the number of the change that is up for a vote, such as #88.

session.card.field.request.description: Row label on a confirmation card in an agent session (the card lists what an action the agent wants to take will be run with, and the person confirms or dismisses it). A noun: the value beside it names a request, a member's filed suggestion or bug report.

session.card.field.links.description: Row label on a confirmation card in an agent session (the card lists what an action the agent wants to take will be run with, and the person confirms or dismisses it). A noun: the value beside it lists the requests this action links the change to.

session.card.field.details.description: Row label on a confirmation card in an agent session (the card lists what an action the agent wants to take will be run with, and the person confirms or dismisses it). The value beside it is the longer text of the request or change.

session.card.value.request.description: Value on a confirmation card in an agent session, beside the label "Request": names one request (a member's filed suggestion or bug report) by its number. {{number}} is that number.

session.card.value.linkedRequest.description: One item in the list of linked requests on a confirmation card in an agent session, beside the label "Links". A noun; {{number}} is the request's number.

session.run.agentOnYourMachine.description: Small line on a run's row in an agent session saying which coding tool did the work when it ran on the person's own computer rather than on Homeroom. {{agent}} is the tool's name, for example Claude Code. Keep the middle dot.

session.checks.skippedReason.text: Checks were skipped: {{reason}}. It can still go live.
session.checks.skippedReason.description: Sentence under a change's status in an agent session when its automated checks did not run. {{reason}} is the server's reason, a phrase without a final full stop. "go live" means the change can still be released.

session.checks.skippedNothingToTest.text: Checks were skipped: there was nothing to test. It can still go live.
session.checks.skippedNothingToTest.description: Sentence under a change's status in an agent session when its automated checks did not run and no reason was recorded. "go live" means the change can still be released.

session.checks.passing.description: Short status of a change's automated checks, on its preview card and in the changes panel of an agent session: all checks pass.

session.checks.skipped.description: Short status of a change's automated checks, on its preview card and in the changes panel of an agent session: the checks did not run, which does not block the change.

session.checks.countFailing_one.description: Short status of a change's automated checks, on its preview card and in the changes panel of an agent session: {{count}} is how many checks fail.

session.checks.countFailing_other.description: Short status of a change's automated checks, on its preview card and in the changes panel of an agent session: {{count}} is how many checks fail.

session.checks.failing.description: Short status of a change's automated checks, on its preview card and in the changes panel of an agent session: some checks fail and the number is not known.

session.checks.running.description: Short status of a change's automated checks, on its preview card and in the changes panel of an agent session: the checks are running now or waiting to start.

session.checks.couldNotRun.description: Short status of a change's automated checks, on its preview card and in the changes panel of an agent session: the checks hit an error and gave no verdict.

session.run.spec.running.description: Heading of a run's row in an agent session's conversation (a run is one piece of work by the coding agent). The agent is writing the plan for the change right now: the written description of what the change will do.

session.run.sync.running.description: Heading of a run's row in an agent session's conversation (a run is one piece of work by the coding agent). The change is being brought up to date with the app's main branch right now; "main" is the branch's name.

session.run.build.running.description: Heading of a run's row in an agent session's conversation (a run is one piece of work by the coding agent). The agent is writing the code of the change right now; "change" is a noun.

session.run.spec.done.description: Heading of a run's row in an agent session's conversation (a run is one piece of work by the coding agent). The agent finished writing the plan for the change: the written description of what the change will do.

session.run.sync.done.description: Heading of a run's row in an agent session's conversation (a run is one piece of work by the coding agent). The change was brought up to date with the app's main branch; "main" is the branch's name.

session.run.build.done.description: Heading of a run's row in an agent session's conversation (a run is one piece of work by the coding agent). The agent finished writing the code of the change; "change" is a noun.

session.run.noChanges.description: Heading of a run's row in an agent session's conversation (a run is one piece of work by the coding agent). The agent finished and changed nothing in the code.

session.run.spec.failed.description: Heading of a run's row in an agent session's conversation (a run is one piece of work by the coding agent). Writing the plan (the written description of what the change will do) failed.

session.run.sync.failed.description: Heading of a run's row in an agent session's conversation (a run is one piece of work by the coding agent). Bringing the change up to date with the app's main branch failed; "main" is the branch's name.

session.run.build.failed.description: Heading of a run's row in an agent session's conversation (a run is one piece of work by the coding agent). Writing the code of the change failed. "build" is a noun: the agent's work on the code.

session.run.spec.stopped.description: Heading of a run's row in an agent session's conversation (a run is one piece of work by the coding agent). The person stopped the agent while it was writing the plan (the written description of what the change will do).

session.run.build.stopped.description: Heading of a run's row in an agent session's conversation (a run is one piece of work by the coding agent). The person stopped the agent while it was writing or syncing the code. "build" is a noun.

session.run.spec.ended.description: Heading of a run's row in an agent session's conversation (a run is one piece of work by the coding agent). An older run that wrote the plan (the written description of what the change will do) is over and its result is not known. "Plan" is a noun.

session.run.sync.ended.description: Heading of a run's row in an agent session's conversation (a run is one piece of work by the coding agent). An older run that synced the change with the main branch is over and its result is not known.

session.run.build.ended.description: Heading of a run's row in an agent session's conversation (a run is one piece of work by the coding agent). An older run that wrote code is over and its result is not known. "Build" is a noun.

session.run.duration.seconds.description: How long a finished run took, when under a minute, shown small beside the run's heading in an agent session. {{seconds}} is a whole number; "s" abbreviates seconds.

session.run.duration.minutes.description: How long a finished run took, a minute or more, shown small beside the run's heading in an agent session. {{minutes}} and {{seconds}} are whole numbers; "m" and "s" abbreviate minutes and seconds.

session.replies.tryAgain.description: Suggested reply offered as a chip under a turn of the agent that failed or was stopped. Pressing it sends these words to the agent as the person's message.

session.replies.whatWentWrong.description: Suggested reply offered as a chip under a turn of the agent that failed or was stopped. Pressing it sends this question to the agent as the person's message.

session.activity.listApps.description: Live status line at the end of an agent session while the agent works, naming what it is doing right now: reading the list of apps.

session.activity.getApp.description: Live status line at the end of an agent session while the agent works, naming what it is doing right now: reading one app's details.

session.activity.listRequests.description: Live status line at the end of an agent session while the agent works, naming what it is doing right now: reading the list of requests (members' filed suggestions and bug reports).

session.activity.getRequest.description: Live status line at the end of an agent session while the agent works, naming what it is doing right now: reading one request (a member's filed suggestion or bug report).

session.activity.getDiscussion.description: Live status line at the end of an agent session while the agent works, naming what it is doing right now: reading a discussion thread.

session.activity.getProposal.description: Live status line at the end of an agent session while the agent works, naming what it is doing right now: reading one proposed code change; "change" is a noun.

session.activity.listMyProposals.description: Live status line at the end of an agent session while the agent works, naming what it is doing right now: looking up the changes the person has put up for a vote.

session.activity.getChange.description: Live status line at the end of an agent session while the agent works, naming what it is doing right now: looking up where the current code change stands; "change" is a noun.

session.activity.getConventions.description: Live status line at the end of an agent session while the agent works, naming what it is doing right now: reading Homeroom's conventions for building apps.

session.activity.webFetch.description: Live status line at the end of an agent session while the agent works, naming what it is doing right now: fetching a page from the web.

session.activity.recheckChange.description: Live status line at the end of an agent session while the agent works, naming what it is doing right now: starting the change's automated checks again.

session.activity.switchChange.description: Live status line at the end of an agent session while the agent works, naming what it is doing right now: moving the conversation to another code change; "changes" is a noun.

session.activity.setFocusApp.description: Live status line at the end of an agent session while the agent works, naming what it is doing right now: moving the conversation to another app.

session.activity.getProdStatus.description: Live status line at the end of an agent session while the agent works, naming what it is doing right now: checking the state of the live, released app.

session.activity.dispatchScout.text: The coding agent is writing the plan
session.activity.dispatchScout.description: Live status line at the end of an agent session while the agent works, naming what it is doing right now: the coding agent has started writing the plan for the change (the written description of what the change will do).

session.activity.dispatchCodingAgent.description: Live status line at the end of an agent session while the agent works, naming what it is doing right now: the coding agent has started writing the code.

session.activity.preparingConfirmation.description: Live status line at the end of an agent session while the agent works, naming what it is doing right now: it is about to ask the person to confirm an action.

session.changeStatus.building.description: State of a code change, in the small pill in an agent session's header and changes panel: the coding agent is working on it right now.

session.changeStatus.inProgress.description: State of a code change, in the small pill in an agent session's header and changes panel: it is being worked on and has not been put up for a vote.

session.changeStatus.waitingForApproval.description: State of a code change, in the small pill in an agent session's header and changes panel: it is up for the community's vote.

session.changeStatus.goingLive.description: State of a code change, in the small pill in an agent session's header and changes panel: it was approved and is being released.

session.changeStatus.live.description: State of a code change, in the small pill in an agent session's header and changes panel: it has been released; an adjective.

session.changeStatus.closed.description: State of a code change, in the small pill in an agent session's header and changes panel: it was archived without being released; an adjective.

session.changeStatus.none.description: State of a code change, in the small pill in an agent session's header and changes panel: the conversation has no change it is working on.

session.error.startFailed.text: Could not start an agent session.
session.error.startFailed.description: Error shown in an agent session when the server gave no sentence of its own: sending the first message could not create the conversation.

session.error.loadFailed.text: Could not load this agent session.
session.error.loadFailed.description: Error shown in an agent session when the server gave no sentence of its own: the conversation could not be loaded.

session.error.modelFailed.description: Error shown in an agent session when the server gave no sentence of its own: the chosen AI model could not be saved for this conversation.

session.error.draftsLoadFailed.text: Could not load your saved drafts.
session.error.draftsLoadFailed.description: Error shown in an agent session when the server gave no sentence of its own: the messages the person saved for later could not be loaded.

session.error.draftSaveFailed.description: Error shown in an agent session when the server gave no sentence of its own: a message could not be saved for later.

session.error.draftDeleteFailed.description: Error shown in an agent session when the server gave no sentence of its own: a saved message could not be deleted.

session.error.renameFailed.description: Error shown in an agent session when the server gave no sentence of its own: the conversation's new name could not be saved.

session.error.archiveFailed.description: Error shown in an agent session when the server gave no sentence of its own: the conversation could not be archived.

session.error.unarchiveFailed.description: Error shown in an agent session when the server gave no sentence of its own: the conversation could not be brought back from the archive.

session.error.handoffStatusFailed.text: Could not check where the hand-off stands.
session.error.handoffStatusFailed.description: Error shown in an agent session when the server gave no sentence of its own: the setup checks for handing work to Claude Code or Codex could not be loaded.

session.error.listFailed.description: Error shown in an agent session when the server gave no sentence of its own: the list of the person's conversations with the agent could not be loaded.

session.error.messagesFailed.description: Error shown in an agent session when the server gave no sentence of its own: the conversation's messages could not be loaded.

session.error.actionsFailed.description: Error shown in an agent session when the server gave no sentence of its own: the confirmation cards (actions waiting for the person's yes) could not be loaded.

session.error.confirmFailed.text: That confirmation did not go through.
session.error.confirmFailed.description: Error shown in an agent session when the server gave no sentence of its own: confirming an action on a confirmation card failed.

session.error.dismissFailed.description: Error shown in an agent session when the server gave no sentence of its own: dismissing a confirmation card failed.

session.error.switchFailed.text: Could not switch to that change.
session.error.switchFailed.description: Error shown in an agent session when the server gave no sentence of its own: the conversation could not be moved to another code change; "change" is a noun.

session.error.stopFailed.text: Could not stop the agent. Try again.
session.error.stopFailed.description: Error shown in an agent session when the server gave no sentence of its own: the request to stop the working agent failed.

session.error.stopCaptureFailed.description: Error shown in an agent session when the server gave no sentence of its own: the request to stop taking preview screenshots failed.

session.error.specFailed.description: Error shown in an agent session when the server gave no sentence of its own: the change's plan (the written description of what the change will do) could not be loaded.

session.error.proposeFailed.text: Could not put this change up for the vote.
session.error.proposeFailed.description: Error shown in an agent session when the server gave no sentence of its own: the change could not be put up for the community's vote; "change" is a noun.

session.error.titleFailed.description: Error shown in an agent session when the server gave no sentence of its own: the change's new title could not be saved; "change" is a verb here.

session.error.rebuildFailed.description: Error shown in an agent session when the server gave no sentence of its own: the preview build of the change could not be started again.

session.error.specVersionFailed.text: Could not load that version of the plan.
session.error.specVersionFailed.description: Error shown in an agent session when the server gave no sentence of its own: an earlier version of the change's plan (the written description of what the change will do) could not be loaded.

session.error.turnRefused.text: The agent could not take that message.
session.error.turnRefused.description: Error shown in an agent session when the server gave no sentence of its own: the server refused the message the person sent to the agent.

session.error.turnFailed.text: The agent could not finish this turn.
session.error.turnFailed.description: Error shown in an agent session when the server gave no sentence of its own: the agent's reply stopped with an error.

session.error.retryFailed.description: Error shown in an agent session when the server gave no sentence of its own: re-running a turn that had not finished failed.

session.error.actionFailed.description: Error shown in an agent session when the server gave no sentence of its own: confirming or dismissing a confirmation card failed.

session.error.turnRefusedNotSent.text: The agent could not take this, so it was not sent.
session.error.turnRefusedNotSent.description: Error shown in an agent session when the server gave no sentence of its own: shown under the person's own unsent message: the server refused it.

session.error.attachFailed.description: Error shown in an agent session when uploading a file to attach to a message failed and the server gave no reason. {{file}} is the file's name.

session.newSessionTitle.description: Title in the header bar of an agent session that has no title yet: a conversation with the coding agent that was just started.

session.outbox.notSentUnreachable.text: Could not reach Homeroom, so this was not sent.
session.outbox.notSentUnreachable.description: Line under the person's own message in an agent session that failed to send, beside a Retry button: the connection to Homeroom failed.

session.outbox.notSentBusy.text: The agent was still answering, so this was not sent.
session.outbox.notSentBusy.description: Line under the person's own message in an agent session that failed to send, beside a Retry button: the agent was in the middle of a reply and could not take another message.

session.outbox.notSent.description: Line under the person's own message in an agent session that failed to send, beside a Retry button: the message never reached the server and the reason is not known.

session.outbox.attachFailedNotSent.text: Could not attach {{file}}, so this was not sent.
session.outbox.attachFailedNotSent.description: Line under the person's own message in an agent session that failed to send, beside a Retry button: uploading one of its files failed. {{file}} is the file's name.

session.outbox.notSentNoCredits.text: Not sent: you are out of credits for now.
session.outbox.notSentNoCredits.description: Line under the person's own message in an agent session that failed to send, beside a Retry button: the person's AI allowance is used up until it renews.

session.outbox.attachedFile.description: Stands in for the text of the person's own message in an agent session when they sent one file and typed nothing. {{file}} is the file's name.

session.outbox.attachedFiles_one.description: Stands in for the text of the person's own message in an agent session when they sent files and typed nothing. {{count}} is how many files (two or more in practice).

session.outbox.attachedFiles_other.description: Stands in for the text of the person's own message in an agent session when they sent files and typed nothing. {{count}} is how many files (two or more in practice).

session.activity.codingAgentWorking.description: Live status line at the end of an agent session while the coding agent (the tool that writes the code) is running.

session.run.progress.working.description: Line in a run's progress log in an agent session, shown in place of a technical phase marker: the coding agent is running.

session.rename.title.description: Title of the small dialog that asks for a new name for the agent session (the conversation with the coding agent).

session.rename.placeholder.description: Placeholder in the text box of the dialog that renames an agent session.

session.rename.confirm.description: Confirm button of the dialog that renames an agent session: a verb, saves the typed name.

session.archive.title.description: Title of the confirmation dialog shown before an agent session is archived. "Archive" is a verb.

session.archive.message.text: It leaves your lists and its change is paused. A change waiting for approval keeps its approvals, and you can unarchive the session at any time.
session.archive.message.description: Body of the confirmation dialog shown before an agent session is archived: what archiving does to the conversation and its code change. "change" is a noun.

session.archive.confirm.description: Confirm button of the dialog shown before an agent session is archived: a verb.

session.drafts.full_one.text: That's {{count}} saved draft. Send or delete one first
session.drafts.full_one.description: Toast in an agent session when the person tries to save a message for later and the list of saved drafts is full. {{count}} is the limit. No final full stop.

session.drafts.full_other.text: That's {{count}} saved drafts. Send or delete one first
session.drafts.full_other.description: Toast in an agent session when the person tries to save a message for later and the list of saved drafts is full. {{count}} is the limit. No final full stop.

session.drafts.saved.text: Draft saved. Send it whenever you're ready
session.drafts.saved.description: Toast in an agent session after the person saved a typed message for later while the agent was busy. No final full stop.

session.drafts.keptTyped.text: Kept what you had typed as another draft
session.drafts.keptTyped.description: Toast in an agent session when the person opened a saved draft while other text was in the message box: that text was saved as a draft of its own. No final full stop.

session.rebuild.stillRunning.text: The rebuild is still running. Its result will appear in this conversation.
session.rebuild.stillRunning.description: Toast in an agent session after "Rebuild preview" was pressed and the build has not finished within the wait.

session.rebuild.unavailable.text: This preview can't be rebuilt right now. Ask the agent to look at the build.
session.rebuild.unavailable.description: Toast in an agent session when "Rebuild preview" was pressed and the server cannot rebuild the change's preview. "build" is a noun.

session.bar.openApp.description: Button in the bar at the top of an agent session (the conversation with Homeroom's coding agent): a verb, opens the app the conversation is about, with this chat docked beside it. Also its accessible name.

session.bar.openAppTitle.text: Open {{app}} with this chat docked beside it
session.bar.openAppTitle.description: Tooltip of the "Open app" button in the bar at the top of an agent session (the conversation with Homeroom's coding agent). {{app}} is the app's name. "Open" is a verb.

session.changeRef.pr.description: How a code change is named in an agent session when it has no title: by its pull request. {{number}} is the pull request's number; PR is the abbreviation of pull request.

session.changeRef.change.description: How a code change is named in an agent session when it has neither a title nor a pull request. A noun; {{number}} is the change's own number.

session.bar.focusTitle.text: The app this conversation is about when a request does not name one. The agent moves it when you ask.
session.bar.focusTitle.description: Tooltip of the app pill in the bar at the top of an agent session (the conversation with Homeroom's coding agent), when no app is chosen yet. "request" here means something the person asks the agent for.

session.bar.focusTitleNamed.text: {{app}}. The app this conversation is about when a request does not name one. The agent moves it when you ask.
session.bar.focusTitleNamed.description: Tooltip of the app pill in the bar at the top of an agent session (the conversation with Homeroom's coding agent). {{app}} is the app's name, said first. "request" here means something the person asks the agent for.

session.bar.noChangeYet.description: Text and tooltip of the status pill in the bar at the top of an agent session (the conversation with Homeroom's coding agent) when the conversation has not started a code change. "change" is a noun.

session.bar.newSession.description: Heading of an agent session shown in the side panel when the conversation has no title yet.

session.bar.kind.description: Small line under the heading of an agent session shown in the side panel: says what kind of conversation this is (one with the coding agent).

session.bar.kindStartedFrom.description: Small line under the heading of an agent session shown in the side panel: what kind of conversation this is and which app it was opened from. {{app}} is the app's name. Keep the middle dot.

session.bar.anyApp.description: Text of the app pill in the bar at the top of an agent session (the conversation with Homeroom's coding agent) when the conversation is not about one particular app.

session.bar.changes_one.description: Button in the bar at the top of an agent session (the conversation with Homeroom's coding agent): opens the list of code changes this conversation has made. "Changes" is a noun; {{count}} is how many there are. Keep the middle dot.

session.bar.changes_other.description: Button in the bar at the top of an agent session (the conversation with Homeroom's coding agent): opens the list of code changes this conversation has made. "Changes" is a noun; {{count}} is how many there are. Keep the middle dot.

session.menu.label.description: Tooltip and accessible name of the ⋯ button in the bar at the top of an agent session (the conversation with Homeroom's coding agent): opens a menu with Rename and Archive.

session.menu.rename.description: Item in the ⋯ menu of an agent session: a verb, opens a dialog to rename the conversation.

session.menu.unarchive.description: Item in the ⋯ menu of an archived agent session: a verb, brings the conversation back.

session.menu.unarchiveTitle.text: Bring this session back to your lists
session.menu.unarchiveTitle.description: Tooltip of "Unarchive" in the ⋯ menu of an agent session.

session.menu.archive.description: Item in the ⋯ menu of an agent session: a verb, archives the conversation.

session.menu.archiveTitle.text: Hide this session from your lists and pause its change
session.menu.archiveTitle.description: Tooltip of "Archive" in the ⋯ menu of an agent session. "change" is a noun, the code change the conversation is working on.

session.join.joinedMessage.description: Message sent to the agent in the person's own name after they pressed Join on a confirmation card in an agent session whose action failed because only members of a community may do it. {{community}} is the community's name, {{action}} the card's title (what the agent tried to do).

session.join.membersOnly.text: Only members of {{community}} can do this. Join it, and the agent will try again.
session.join.membersOnly.description: Explanation on a confirmation card in an agent session whose action failed because only members of a community may do it. {{community}} is the community's name.

session.join.joined.text: Joined. Asked the agent to try again.
session.join.joined.description: Shown beside a check mark on a confirmation card in an agent session whose action failed because only members of a community may do it, after the person joined it.

session.join.button.description: Button on a confirmation card in an agent session whose action failed because only members of a community may do it: a verb, makes the person a member. {{community}} is the community's name.

session.join.failed.text: That did not work. Try again.
session.join.failed.description: Red note beside the Join button on a confirmation card in an agent session whose action failed because only members of a community may do it, when joining failed.

session.card.label.description: Accessible name of a confirmation card in an agent session. {{action}} is the card's title, what the agent wants to do.

session.card.needsOk.description: Small label at the top of a card on a confirmation card in an agent session (the agent asks before it takes an action, and the person confirms or declines) while it waits for the person's answer.

session.card.confirm.description: Button on a confirmation card in an agent session (the agent asks before it takes an action, and the person confirms or declines): a verb, lets the agent go ahead with the action.

session.card.notNow.description: Button on a confirmation card in an agent session (the agent asks before it takes an action, and the person confirms or declines): declines the action for now; nothing is changed.

session.card.waiting.text: Waiting for the agent to finish…
session.card.waiting.description: Small note on a confirmation card in an agent session (the agent asks before it takes an action, and the person confirms or declines) shown while the agent is still writing its reply, before the buttons appear.

session.card.running.description: Status beside a spinner on a confirmation card in an agent session (the agent asks before it takes an action, and the person confirms or declines) after the person confirmed: the action is being carried out.

session.card.confirmed.description: Status beside a check mark on a confirmation card in an agent session (the agent asks before it takes an action, and the person confirms or declines): the action was carried out.

session.card.confirmedOutcome.description: Status beside a check mark on a confirmation card in an agent session (the agent asks before it takes an action, and the person confirms or declines): the action was carried out. {{outcome}} is the server's one-line result. Keep the middle dot.

session.card.failed.description: Red status on a confirmation card in an agent session (the agent asks before it takes an action, and the person confirms or declines): the confirmed action failed and no reason is known.

session.card.failedOutcome.description: Red status on a confirmation card in an agent session (the agent asks before it takes an action, and the person confirms or declines): the confirmed action failed. {{outcome}} is the server's reason.

session.card.dismissed.description: Grey status on a confirmation card in an agent session (the agent asks before it takes an action, and the person confirms or declines) after the person pressed "Not now".

session.card.expired.text: This confirmation expired. Ask again for a fresh one.
session.card.expired.description: Grey status on a confirmation card in an agent session (the agent asks before it takes an action, and the person confirms or declines) that waited too long and can no longer be confirmed.

session.reply.agent.description: Small green label above each reply of the coding agent in an agent session: who is speaking.

session.reply.agentWithCost.description: Small label above each reply of the coding agent in an agent session: who is speaking, then what that reply cost in AI credits, in muted ink. {{cost}} is a dollar amount such as $0.012, or ~$0.012 for an estimate. "reply" is a noun, lower case. Keep the <0> tags around the dot and the cost.

session.run.took.description: Shown after the heading of a finished run in an agent session. {{duration}} is how long it took, already worded, for example 45s or 1m 20s. Keep the parentheses.

session.run.starting.description: Body of a run's card in an agent session while the coding agent has started and written nothing yet.

session.run.noOutput.description: Body of a finished run's card in an agent session when the coding agent wrote nothing.

session.preview.failed.description: Red heading on a change's preview card in an agent session (the preview is a test build of the app with the change in it): the test build failed.

session.preview.ready.description: Heading on a change's preview card in an agent session (the preview is a test build of the app with the change in it): the test build is ready to open.

session.preview.failedSuperseded.text: The preview failed to build · Superseded by a newer preview
session.preview.failedSuperseded.description: Grey line that replaces an older preview card whose build had failed, once a newer preview exists. Keep the middle dot.

session.preview.readySuperseded.text: Preview ready · Superseded by a newer preview
session.preview.readySuperseded.description: Grey line that replaces an older preview card whose build was ready, once a newer preview exists. Keep the middle dot.

session.preview.status.live.description: Small pill on a change's preview card in an agent session (the preview is a test build of the app with the change in it): the change has been released; an adjective.

session.preview.status.waiting.description: Small pill on a change's preview card in an agent session (the preview is a test build of the app with the change in it): the change is up for the community's vote.

session.preview.checksTitle.text: See each check and its result
session.preview.checksTitle.description: Tooltip of the checks status on a change's preview card in an agent session (the preview is a test build of the app with the change in it); pressing it opens the list of automated checks.

session.preview.retrying.description: Text of the Retry button on a change's preview card in an agent session (the preview is a test build of the app with the change in it) while the failed build is being started again.

session.preview.retry.description: Button on a change's preview card in an agent session (the preview is a test build of the app with the change in it) whose build failed: a verb, builds the preview again.

session.preview.open.description: Button on a change's preview card in an agent session (the preview is a test build of the app with the change in it): a verb, shows the test build of the app.

session.preview.viewChange.description: Link on a change's preview card in an agent session (the preview is a test build of the app with the change in it) once the change is in a vote or released: opens the change's page. "change" is a noun.

session.preview.openDraft.description: Link on a change's preview card in an agent session (the preview is a test build of the app with the change in it) while the change is still a draft: opens the change's page. "Open" is a verb, "change" a noun.

session.preview.recheckTitle.text: Rebuild the preview if needed and run the automated checks again, on the same commit
session.preview.recheckTitle.description: Tooltip of the "Re-run checks" button on a change's preview card in an agent session (the preview is a test build of the app with the change in it). A commit is a saved version of the code.

session.preview.rechecking.description: Text of the "Re-run checks" button on a change's preview card in an agent session (the preview is a test build of the app with the change in it) while the checks are being started again.

session.preview.recheck.description: Button on a change's preview card in an agent session (the preview is a test build of the app with the change in it) whose automated checks failed or could not run: runs them again.

session.fixChecks.label.description: Accessible name of the card at the end of an agent session that lists a change's failing automated checks and offers to fix them.

session.fixChecks.more_one.description: Line under the list of failing checks on the card at the end of an agent session that offers to fix a change's failing automated checks. {{count}} is how many more checks failed than are listed.

session.fixChecks.more_other.description: Line under the list of failing checks on the card at the end of an agent session that offers to fix a change's failing automated checks. {{count}} is how many more checks failed than are listed.

session.fixChecks.explain.text: Checks have to pass before the change can merge. The agent can read what failed and fix it.
session.fixChecks.explain.description: Explanation on the card at the end of an agent session that offers to fix a change's failing automated checks. "change" is a noun; "merge" means the change being accepted into the app.

session.fixChecks.fix.description: Main button on the card at the end of an agent session that offers to fix a change's failing automated checks: asks the agent to fix the failing checks.

session.fixChecks.see.description: Second button on the card at the end of an agent session that offers to fix a change's failing automated checks: opens the list of checks and their results.

session.specCard.title.description: Title of the small plan card in an agent session's conversation (the plan is the written description of what a change will do), when neither its version nor its length is known. A noun.

session.specCard.titleVersion.description: Title of the small plan card in an agent session's conversation (the plan is the written description of what a change will do). {{version}} is the plan's version number, after the letter v.

session.specCard.titleLines_one.description: Title of the small plan card in an agent session's conversation (the plan is the written description of what a change will do). {{count}} is how many lines the plan has. Keep the middle dot.

session.specCard.titleLines_other.description: Title of the small plan card in an agent session's conversation (the plan is the written description of what a change will do). {{count}} is how many lines the plan has. Keep the middle dot.

session.specCard.titleVersionLines_one.description: Title of the small plan card in an agent session's conversation (the plan is the written description of what a change will do). {{version}} is the plan's version number, after the letter v. {{count}} is how many lines the plan has. Keep the middle dot.

session.specCard.titleVersionLines_other.description: Title of the small plan card in an agent session's conversation (the plan is the written description of what a change will do). {{version}} is the plan's version number, after the letter v. {{count}} is how many lines the plan has. Keep the middle dot.

session.specCard.open.description: Accessible name of the small plan card in an agent session's conversation (the plan is the written description of what a change will do), which opens the full plan when pressed. "Open" is a verb; "Plan" is the card's title.

session.specCard.openVersion.description: Accessible name of the small plan card in an agent session's conversation (the plan is the written description of what a change will do), which opens the full plan when pressed. "Open" is a verb. {{version}} is the plan's version number, after the letter v.

session.specCard.openLines_one.description: Accessible name of the small plan card in an agent session's conversation (the plan is the written description of what a change will do), which opens the full plan when pressed. "Open" is a verb. {{count}} is how many lines the plan has.

session.specCard.openLines_other.description: Accessible name of the small plan card in an agent session's conversation (the plan is the written description of what a change will do), which opens the full plan when pressed. "Open" is a verb. {{count}} is how many lines the plan has.

session.specCard.openVersionLines_one.description: Accessible name of the small plan card in an agent session's conversation (the plan is the written description of what a change will do), which opens the full plan when pressed. "Open" is a verb. {{version}} is the plan's version number, after the letter v. {{count}} is how many lines the plan has.

session.specCard.openVersionLines_other.description: Accessible name of the small plan card in an agent session's conversation (the plan is the written description of what a change will do), which opens the full plan when pressed. "Open" is a verb. {{version}} is the plan's version number, after the letter v. {{count}} is how many lines the plan has.

session.specCard.viewFull.description: Call to action at the right of the small plan card in an agent session: opens the whole plan (the written description of what the change will do). Keep the arrow last.

session.spec.sectionsLabel.description: Accessible name of the two tabs (User-facing, Technical) in the plan viewer of an agent session (the plan is the written description of what a change will do).

session.spec.tab.userFacing.description: Tab in the plan viewer of an agent session (the plan is the written description of what a change will do): the part of the plan that describes what people will see.

session.spec.tab.technical.description: Tab in the plan viewer of an agent session (the plan is the written description of what a change will do): the part of the plan that describes how the code will change.

session.spec.emptySection.description: Shown in the plan viewer of an agent session (the plan is the written description of what a change will do) when the chosen tab (User-facing or Technical) has no text.

session.spec.heading.description: Heading of the plan viewer of an agent session: the written description of what a change will do. A noun.

session.spec.subtitleWithApp.description: Small line under the heading of the plan viewer: which change the plan belongs to and its app. {{change}} is the change's title, or a reference such as PR #12; {{app}} is the app's name. Keep the middle dot.

session.spec.versionLabel.description: Accessible name of the drop-down in the plan viewer of an agent session (the plan is the written description of what a change will do) that picks which version of the plan to read.

session.spec.none.text: This change has no plan yet.
session.spec.none.description: Shown in the plan viewer of an agent session when the change has no plan (written description of what it will do). "change" is a noun.

session.spec.dialogLabel.description: Accessible name of the sheet that shows a change's plan (the written description of what it will do) over an agent session. A noun.

session.sidePane.tabsLabel.description: Accessible name of the two tabs (Plan, Preview) of the pane docked beside an agent session's conversation on a wide screen.

session.sidePane.tab.spec.description: Tab of the pane docked beside an agent session's conversation on a wide screen: shows the change's plan, the written description of what it will do. A noun.

session.sidePane.tab.preview.description: Tab of the pane docked beside an agent session's conversation on a wide screen: shows the test build of the app with the change in it. A noun.

session.sidePane.resizePreview.description: Accessible name of the draggable divider between the conversation and the docked preview in an agent session.

session.sidePane.resizeSpec.description: Accessible name of the draggable divider between the conversation and the docked plan (the written description of what the change will do) in an agent session.

session.sidePane.previewLabel.description: Accessible name of the pane docked beside an agent session's conversation on a wide screen while it shows the test build of the app. A noun.

session.sidePane.specLabel.description: Accessible name of the pane docked beside an agent session's conversation on a wide screen while it shows the change's plan, the written description of what it will do. A noun.

session.outbox.retryBusyTitle.text: The agent is still working. You can send this when it finishes
session.outbox.retryBusyTitle.description: Tooltip of the disabled Retry button under an unsent message in an agent session, while the agent is busy. No final full stop.

session.outbox.retryTitle.description: Tooltip of the Retry button under an unsent message in an agent session.

session.outbox.edit.description: Button under the person's own unsent message in an agent session: a verb, puts the text back in the message box to change it.

session.outbox.discard.description: Button under the person's own unsent message in an agent session: a verb, throws the unsent message away.

session.live.stopping.description: Live status line at the end of an agent session after the person pressed Stop, while the agent winds down.

session.live.wrappingUp.description: Live status line at the end of an agent session while the agent writes its closing reply after the coding work finished.

session.live.thinking.description: Screen-reader text beside the animated dots at the end of an agent session while the agent prepares its reply.

session.elapsed.description: Running clock beside the live status line in an agent session: how long the current work has taken. {{minutes}} and {{seconds}} are whole numbers; "m" and "s" abbreviate minutes and seconds.

session.capture.heading.description: Status line in an agent session while Homeroom takes before-and-after screenshots of a change. Keep the <0> tags around the first words, which are shown stronger. Used when the current step is not known.

session.capture.provisioning.text: <0>Capturing previews</0> · Preparing the before and after builds
session.capture.provisioning.description: Status line in an agent session while Homeroom takes before-and-after screenshots of a change. Keep the <0> tags around the first words, which are shown stronger; after the dot, the current step: both versions of the app are being started.

session.capture.exploring.text: <0>Capturing previews</0> · Finding the screens to capture
session.capture.exploring.description: Status line in an agent session while Homeroom takes before-and-after screenshots of a change. Keep the <0> tags around the first words, which are shown stronger; after the dot, the current step: looking for the screens the change affects.

session.capture.replaying.text: <0>Capturing previews</0> · Replaying the flow on both builds
session.capture.replaying.description: Status line in an agent session while Homeroom takes before-and-after screenshots of a change. Keep the <0> tags around the first words, which are shown stronger; after the dot, the current step: the same steps are repeated on the old and new versions of the app.

session.capture.reviewing.description: Status line in an agent session while Homeroom takes before-and-after screenshots of a change. Keep the <0> tags around the first words, which are shown stronger; after the dot, the current step: the screenshots are being saved.

session.capture.stopping.description: Text of the Stop button beside the "Capturing previews" status line in an agent session while the capture is being stopped.

session.capture.stop.description: Button beside the "Capturing previews" status line in an agent session: a verb, stops taking the screenshots.

session.empty.requestHeading.description: Heading in the empty state of a new agent session that was started from a request (a member's filed suggestion or bug report). A noun; {{number}} is the request's number.

session.empty.requestBody.text: Send the message below to start. The agent reads the request, plans the change with you, and asks the group for approval when you say so.
session.empty.requestBody.description: Paragraph in the empty state of a new agent session that was started from a request (a member's filed suggestion or bug report). "change" is a noun; "the group" is the app's community.

session.empty.requestBodyOnApp.text: On <0>{{app}}</0>. Send the message below to start. The agent reads the request, plans the change with you, and asks the group for approval when you say so.
session.empty.requestBodyOnApp.description: Paragraph in the empty state of a new agent session that was started from a request on a known app. {{app}} is the app's name, shown in bold: keep the <0> tags around it. "change" is a noun; "the group" is the app's community.

session.empty.heading.description: Heading in the empty state of a new agent session: a conversation with Homeroom's coding agent in which nothing has been said yet.

session.empty.body.text: Start a change on any app. The agent plans it, builds it, and asks the group for approval when you say so.
session.empty.body.description: Paragraph in the empty state of a new agent session. "change" is a noun, a change to an app's code; "the group" is the app's community.

session.empty.bodyFromApp.text: Started from <0>{{app}}</0>. Start a change on any app. The agent plans it, builds it, and asks the group for approval when you say so.
session.empty.bodyFromApp.description: Paragraph in the empty state of a new agent session that was opened from an app. {{app}} is that app's name, shown in bold: keep the <0> tags around it. "change" is a noun; "the group" is the app's community.

session.starter.aboutChange.description: Suggested first message offered as a chip above the message box of a new agent session; pressing it puts these words in the box as the person's own message. Offered when the session was opened from a proposed change; "change" is a noun.

session.starter.openOnApp.description: Suggested first message offered as a chip above the message box of a new agent session; pressing it puts these words in the box as the person's own message: asks what requests and changes are in progress on the app. {{app}} is the app's name.

session.starter.whatToWorkOn.description: Suggested first message offered as a chip above the message box of a new agent session; pressing it puts these words in the box as the person's own message. Offered when the session is not about one app.

session.starter.addFeature.description: Suggested first message offered as a chip above the message box of a new agent session; pressing it puts these words in the box as the person's own message.

session.starter.fixBug.description: Suggested first message offered as a chip above the message box of a new agent session; pressing it puts these words in the box as the person's own message.

session.model.fallbackLabel.description: Text of the model button beside the message box of an agent session when the chosen AI model has no name to show.

session.composer.busyPlaceholder.text: The agent is working. Type your next message and save it for later.
